## Limits and transparency

- We do not publish sponsored content or paid reviews.
- Affiliate relationships never influence conclusions.
- We publish corrections when we're wrong.
- We write from experience, not press releases.
- All code examples are yours to use under MIT license unless otherwise noted.

## FAQ

**What kind of content does TechFlow Blog publish?**
{{faq_1_answer}}

**How often do you publish new articles?**
We don't publish on a fixed schedule. Reviews typically take 1-2 weeks of testing, tutorials are published when verified working, and opinion pieces when there's something substantive to say.

**Is all content free?**
{{faq_4_answer}}

**Can I suggest a topic?**
{{faq_5_answer}}

**Do you accept sponsored content?**
No. We never publish sponsored content or paid reviews. Our conclusions are never influenced by affiliate relationships.

**Can I use your code examples?**
{{faq_15_answer}}
